verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents event-triggered flows and automation building, even on the free plan, so automations run in the background on Klaviyo events. Its AI features add autonomous behavior: Customer Agent sends order updates automatically, K:AI picks the delivery channel, and Composer builds the audience, content and send strategy and carries the work through. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on flow configuration and triggers, explicit evidence that AI or MCP can create or modify automation flows (MCP evidence covers only campaign creation and flow reports), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
